title: Verificar en navegador el candidate hash-gated de José V11
mission: Open the isolated public Jose V11 candidate in a representative JavaScript browser, require its immutable-source byte-count/SHA-256 gate to pass before interaction, then smoke-test the recovered topic-local study flow and applicable R07 eraser/undo interaction invariants without modifying V11 or promoting any authority pointer.
definition_of_done: https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/candidates/jose-v11-reviewable-preview/ loads in a representative JavaScript browser after Pages propagation.
The wrapper reaches VERIFIED only after decoded bytes equal 69235 and SHA-256 equals 0cf9a40fb53e977dccb40c9755d668a3ee922ccd61883f19229bb4a113139a05.
The four topic-local map/practice surfaces are smoke-tested after the verification gate passes.
Wheel/trackpad and grab-drag behavior are checked where the V11 surface exposes them.
Where eraser/undo behavior is present, pressed-only eraser and reversibility constraints from R07 are regression-checked.
No Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served pointer is changed.
